DIAGNOSIS READY: Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood.

The patient presents with significant emotional and behavioral symptoms (loss of interest in cheerleading, irritability) following a stressor (implied social/academic change), yet she explicitly denies the core criteria for Major Depressive Disorder (no sleep disturbance, weight change, hopelessness) and has normal cognitive function.
